recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,819.25 (+1.85%) and the Sensex at 83,938.28 (+1.82%); Bank Nifty moved +1.79%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) +1.66%, mid caps (Midcap 150) +0.22%, small caps (Smallcap 250) -0.18%.
FMCG led the sectors (+3.79%), while Media lagged (-4.44%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was Jupiter Wagons (+20.00%); biggest faller was APL Apollo Tubes (-11.62%). Breadth: 270 advances vs 228 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 0.50% and the Nasdaq down 1.48%.
The rupee is at 92.22 per dollar, Brent at $88.59 (-3.07%) and gold at $3,526 (-1.01%).
